BTL rate pages must be read with a browser UA, not a bare curl/WebFetch (403). Keep the live BTL URLs percent-encoded in evidence.json as the source of record.

stable_success: what's my net salary after bituach leumi
what stock should I buy (negative, correctly not routed)
should I take fixed or variable mortgage

lessons: COVERAGE-GAP fixed (CRITICAL): the BL/health employee rate was ONE row of a 12-row official table. Under-18s and old-age-pension recipients pay 0% employee contributions and disability-pension recipients pay health tax only, so the script over-deducted them by the entire amount. Added an 8-row category table plus --category. Every derived BL/health split was checked to sum exactly to the published combined rate.

STALE fixed (CRITICAL): the mortgage mix rule said at least 1/3 must be fixed-UNLINKED. The source says only 'בריבית קבועה'; a CPI-linked fixed track satisfies it. Overstating it removed the cheaper option from the borrower's choice set. The evidence snippet had been verbatim and CORRECT all along while the claim text paraphrased it wrongly, which the self-consistency gate cannot catch. Check claim-vs-snippet, not just snippet-vs-page.

Three unsourced figures removed after the Judge checked the cited page: mortgage insurance '100-300 NIS/month', 'banks decline above 40% PTI', and 'the 1/3-prime cap was removed in January 2021'. The kolzchut page contains zero occurrences of פריים, 40%, or 2021. Long-standing numbers can be unsourced; re-grep the page rather than trusting inheritance.

Expert CRITICALs resolved: child credit points, the pension-contribution tax credit, keren hishtalmut, second-employer tiaum, taxable benefits and the self-employed are now named in a 'What the net-pay estimate does NOT include' section in both languages and in the script docstring. Self-employed moved to domain-checklist 'Out of scope (explicit)'. Acquisition costs (mas rechisha, lawyer, broker, appraiser, registration) added beside the LTV equity requirement. Script now hard-errors above a 30-year term instead of pricing a loan no bank may grant.

Legal gate returned Tier B NOTICE_REQUIRED (not BLOCK): Example 3 emits a maximum-loan conclusion about the user's own facts (S2 under לבנת פורן) while the name stays neutral (F1). No reserved profession is engaged (there is no Israeli licensure statute for יועץ משכנתאות; יועץ מס is representation-scoped; רו"ח excludes ניהול חשבונות). Notice added after the H1 in both files and a short clause prepended to both descriptions. Never remove or reword that opening clause.
